title: What do these six subtractions of the other colour give?
description: Six subtractions are evaluated with tokens. Each takes away tokens of the colour the tray does not hold, so zero pairs are put in first. The tokens that stay give each answer and its sign.
teaching_notes: One idea: put in one zero pair for each token to take away, then lift those tokens off. Watch for students who think taking away a token of the other colour must make the value smaller.

video_script.why: The child evaluates six subtractions with tokens of the other colour, by putting in a zero pair for each token to take away.
video_script.substitution: Put in one zero pair for each token to take away, lift those tokens off, and read the answer from the tokens that stay.
video_script.anchor: a tray of positive and negative tokens
video_script.payoff_line: The six answers are negative thirteen, positive fifteen, negative fourteen, negative nineteen, positive ten and negative nine.

final_answer.spoken: negative thirteen, positive fifteen, negative fourteen, negative nineteen, positive ten and negative nine

maths_rules: (−3) − (+10): 10 zero pairs; 3 + 10 = 13 negative tokens stay, so −13
(+8) − (−7): 7 zero pairs; 8 + 7 = 15 positive tokens stay, so +15
(−5) − (+9): 9 zero pairs; 5 + 9 = 14 negative tokens stay, so −14
(−9) − (+10): 10 zero pairs; 9 + 10 = 19 negative tokens stay, so −19
(+6) − (−4): 4 zero pairs; 6 + 4 = 10 positive tokens stay, so +10
(−2) − (+7): 7 zero pairs; 2 + 7 = 9 negative tokens stay, so −9
check: 13 negative and 10 positive less 10 zero pairs = 3 negative; 15 positive and 7 negative less 7 zero pairs = 8 positive; the other four check in the same way
video_script.design: Six subtractions on one board. In each, the zero pairs put in equal the tokens to take away, so the tokens that stay are the start plus the tokens taken. The check puts the taken tokens back.

<bookmark mark='d'/>The fourth has nine negative tokens, so we put in ten zero pairs. Nineteen negative tokens stay.
<bookmark mark='f'/>The last has two negative tokens, so we put in seven zero pairs. Nine negative tokens stay.
